headline: Godcrofts, Farranac Register Fresh Base Action
war_summary: Since the last edition, the sharpest movement has shifted toward Godcrofts and Farranac Coast. Godcrofts recorded five base events in the past two hours and seven in six, with two strategic holdings now neutral and the sector standing at seven Warden-held bases, none Colonial, and two unclaimed. Farranac posted three fresh events, including a neutralization and a Colonial capture; its ledger remains divided nine Colonial to two Warden bases. Fisherman’s Row, previously the busiest immediate front, has gone quiet in the latest two hours, though six events in six hours and 25 across the day leave its five-to-four split unsettled. Deadlands likewise shows no two-hour activity but four events in six and 15 in 24 hours, while its casualty rates remain immense despite cooling enlistments. Linn Mercy and Lykos Isle retain recent daily movement without fresh events in the near window. Clahstra and Weathered Expanse continue to report the heaviest fighting by casualties, yet neither has logged a base event. The remaining sectors appear largely settled or quiet.
